    Fischbacher's theorem for the small model #

    Cancellation, chain-boundedness and connectivity by nonzero zigzags pass to the small model RaySmall P; hence its fundamental group is free when that of the conditions hold for P (RayCat.RaySmall.isFreeGroup_end).

      Fischbacher, no-crown case, small model. For a split basic distributive minimal representation-infinite algebra whose ray category is chain-bounded, the vertex groups of the fundamental groupoid of the small model are free.
